translated:
( A secret underground passage the
Dipan royal family built long ago. )
( At the price of many sacrifices. )
Can we really walk from here to Dipan?
You're not deceiving me, are you?

Will you fight together with me
for Midgard a while longer?

( Let me out too!
I'll fight as much as you want! )

When the time comes, I will surely
have need of your strength as well.

I will call if anything happens,
so stay here until then.
